ownership: North district manifests/editor adapter and native goods, transport, rowing, deeds/shops, actions/routines, events/town life, gifts/treats/hands, families/walk-up, resident async talk, visitors/emigrants/surprises, haggle and trade ledger. Root owns shared builds, factory, renderer, user playtest and commits.
runtime: Native C# and SQLite in process. No browser, Node, TypeScript, original GLB or external HTTP service is a runtime dependency. Recovery scripts read source/fresh in-memory databases only.

integration.talk: Keep deeds.Talk as a FullTalkOverrides callback before ordinary dialogue. Attach Gifts/Treats/Hands/Families/Emigrants/Surprises/Haggle once. Inventory, pay and source extra choices run in engine callbacks.
integration.narration: Wire NarrateAsync on Talk/Routines/Events/TownLife/Hands/Families/Surprises/Haggle. Connect CanUseHook to chosen hook availability and DailyCallLimit to AI settings. Providers wait outside host.WithState; short serialized sections validate and apply effects. NewGame/Loaded generations invalidate stale completions.
integration.budgets: Resident40/day and15-call reserve; ordinary talk and haggle3/meeting. Director12/day, check-ins6/day and5/routine, hiring1/day, hand words2/day, family share3/day, stranger/twist/dream3/day, NPC scheme conversations10/day. Zero total-day cap leaves module limits in force.
integration.nightPerception: Night.SyncPerception=actions.Sync; PlayerPosition=actions.PlayerPosition; PeopleNear=actions.PeopleNear; CallGang=walkup.CallGang; EndCallsFor=prefix=>actions.EndCallsFor(prefix). Wire Ideas trouble to the same actual resident/responder executor.
integration.navigation: Transport.GroundOpen, Actions.NearestOpen and TradeLedger.WayBetween use native support/navigation. Ledger dispatch/drove have no invented straight-path fallback.
integration.population: Visitors.Ensure and Emigrants adapter.Ensure run after base generation and before landmark/vehicle/transport/lively additions. Saved v1 records survive. Emigrants picks fresh native free doors and generates seed-derived families. Six visitor archetypes have source-authored fixed stats/ages.
integration.assetOwners: Wire Deeds.Stealables; Rowing.BoatDefinitions/PublicBoats/LandingWaterman; Transport.TransportRecord/TripPoints/Errands to current native population. Preserve saved object/deed/boat identities.
integration.lamps: Deeds.WorkLamps and LampLight use stable editable native lamp IDs, owners, transforms and lit state. Rendering, theft and lamplighter jobs refer to the same objects.
integration.events: Events.EventPeopleMax uses event-size setting; Events.EmigrantShip=emigrants.Ship. Family gatherings select real due emigrants aged6+. Planned events write world_event refs for press/ballad facts.
integration.ledger: Construct/configure NativeTradeLedger before the first board, AddModule, then mills.StockEventHooks.Add(ledger.OnMillEvents). It composes fish-haul, seller price, buyer line, board/take/settle and clock hooks. Source40 actual cases prove market rounded before shelf band. No old Mills.BreadExtra inflation.
integration.personalDeals: CoreTrade.Wares remains current list price for facts. PersonalWares applies this player's deal. Buy checks refusal/agreed price, consumes discounted purchases and applies shelf consumption. Deals/grudges are player-scoped; shelves/runs are world-scoped.
integration.clock: GameMinute=(day-1)*1440+hour*60+minute. Rest/interior MinuteNow uses day*1440. TickAfterHooks also runs after dev clock changes. SleepEndedHooks runs after actual sleep/collapse/cell dawn, including dreams.
integration.workers: NativeHands.After owns goods selection/pickup/cart/placement/progress. Client walks and reports current i/ok/n/x/z and selected gid/gids; no second goods mutation or HaulRun.OnPlaced on native backend.

proof.isolation: Fresh in-memory SQLite. SDK outputs outside Godot at .scratch/north-services-durable-proof; durable proof source is .cs.txt. Godot excludes services/proofs/**/*.cs. No shared build, engine launch or live save writes.
covers: 644 stable physical goods and real holdings
personal bargain purchases and seller refusal
provider lock release and reset invalidation
proof.evidence: .scratch/north-final-proof.log; original fixtures services/proofs/data. Root owns rendered/gameplay/editor/GPU verification.

fidelityReview: Optional generic Actions.Conversation still has a handwritten fallback; police/custom confrontation story rating/speech retain the checked engine path. Explicit narration review is needed before claiming full optional AI parity.

Fire/hiring seed1873 casting/geometry baselines were recovered as fixtures. Inspect source choices when a fresh town changes ownership; complex funeral lead casting and script details need separate comparison.
Rule proofs do not certify GPU material quality, reflected geometry, movable collision, crowd paths or editor convenience. Root performs visual/gameplay review and the user test.
Immediate prison dawn and the current shared in-process host are single-player behaviour. Multiplayer requires per-player sessions/events/save coordination; Together stays disabled until checked.
